children: Agasti Kaulgi has joined PwC India as Director, Media Relations and Communications, marking a move to the Big Four professional services firm after nearly seven years with Tata Motors.

Kaulgi said of the appointment on LinkedIn, describing it as an “exciting new chapter” in his professional career. He said the new role would provide an opportunity to work across sectors and engage with new perspectives.

He joins PwC India after serving as Deputy General Manager – Corporate Communications at Tata Motors from December 2019 to October 2026. At Tata Motors, he was responsible for integrated corporate and brand communication across more than 40 international markets, including reputation management, content strategy, public relations and leadership positioning.

During his tenure, Kaulgi also led communication programmes around product launches, global showcases, mobility forums, media immersions and CXO communication initiatives. His work included thought leadership, executive visibility and stakeholder engagement across mobility, technology and sustainability.

Before Tata Motors, Kaulgi had a brief stint at GoAir as Senior Manager – Corporate Communications, where he handled corporate communications, public relations, crisis and reputation management, executive communication and strategic content.

Kaulgi brings around 15 years of experience spanning corporate communications, public relations, digital strategy, journalism and brand storytelling. His earlier career was rooted in journalism, including more than eight years as Senior Features Editor at BBC TopGear Magazine with Worldwide Media.

At BBC TopGear, he worked on automotive content strategy, editorial programmes, product reviews, brand storytelling and experiential initiatives. He also served as a jury member for automotive awards, including the Indian Car of the Year (ICOTY), Times Auto Awards and BBC TopGear Awards.
Kaulgi holds a Master’s degree in Mass Media, Multimedia Journalism and Marketing from Mumbai Educational Trust and a Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science from the University of Mumbai.
